title: Zesty Portuguese Bread Toast
description: Crispy toast made with stale bread infused with Portuguese tadka, herbs, and a splash of olive oil, perfect for a romantic snack.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and swirl in the olive oil.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Sprinkle oregano, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper over the garlic and stir to combine.
Place the bread slices in the skillet, cooking each side for 2-3 minutes until golden and crisp.
Remove the toasted bread from the skillet and sprinkle with fresh parsley for garnish.
Serve immediately as a warm, herb-infused snack.
Enjoy the romantic and zesty flavors of Portuguese cuisine.
